item.title: [org.clojars.jj/iso-countries "1.2.5"]
item.description:
iso-countries is a Clojure library designed to provide easy access to comprehensive ISO 3166 1 country data.
This library aims to simplify the process of retrieving country-specific information, including official names, alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes, numeric codes, regional classifications, and unicode flags.
